maddeler.e:
نخرمص (form IVq)
# نَخْرَمِصُّ (naḵramiṣṣu) /nax.ra.misˤ.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْرَمَصَّ (iḵramaṣṣa)
# نَخْرَمِصَّ (naḵramiṣṣa) /nax.ra.misˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْرَمَصَّ (iḵramaṣṣa)
# نَخْرَمِصِّ (naḵramiṣṣi) /nax.ra.misˤ.sˤi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْرَمَصَّ (iḵramaṣṣa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
